reason: E4 supports laser cladding as a method and CoCrFeNi HEAs for toughness, and E2 supports WC hardness, but no cited evidence demonstrates that WC particles inhibit hot cracking, that rapid solidification of this specific HEA-WC composite refines grains and bonds metallurgically, or that the composite synergistically improves wear and corrosion resistance while reducing hot cracking. The key mechanistic and performance premises are largely unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Laser cladding is an effective, environmentally friendly surface modification method.
CoCrFeNi-based HEAs have excellent ductility and fracture toughness.
WC particles provide high hardness and can act as crack inhibitors.
Rapid solidification during laser cladding refines microstructure and promotes metallurgical bonding.
HEA-WC composite coatings can simultaneously enhance hardness, wear resistance, and corrosion resistance.
